paite: Huan Sabbath ni abei in, ani sagih ni masapen ding a phalvak in, han en ding in Mari Magdalin leh Mari dang akuan uhi.
heading: Jesu Thohnawnna / (Mar 16.1-10; Luk 23.1-12; Joh 20.1-10)
english: Now after the Sabbath, as it began to dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.

paite: Ngai dih, nakpitak in ziin ahong ling a; van a kipan Toupa angel ahong suk a, suang ahong khukkhia a, atung ah atuta hi.
english: Behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from the sky and came and rolled away the stone from the door and sat on it.

paite: Amel omdan khophia bang ahi a, apuansilhte tuh vuk bang in angou hi;
english: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.

paite: Amah akihtak ziak un veng mite aling ua, misi bang in a-om hial uhi.
english: For fear of him, the guards shook, and became like dead men.

paite: Angel in numeite ahoupih a, akiang uah, "Nou zaw lau kei un; akilhden uh Jesu zong na hi uh chih ka thei;
english: The angel answered the women, “Don’t be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus, who has been crucified.

paite: hiai ah a-omta kei; agen bang ngei in athounawnta, alupna mun en un, achi hi.
english: He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Come, see the place where the Lord was lying.

paite: Pai meng unla, nungzuite kiang ah, 'Misi lak a kipan athounawnta hi. Ngai dih uh, Galili gam ah na ma uah apai; huai ah amah na mu ding uh' chi in hilh un. Ngai dih uh, ka hon hilhta ahi," achi hi.
english: Go quickly and tell his disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead, and behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there you will see him.’ Behold, I have told you.”

paite: Huan lau leh kipak mahmah kawm in, han a kipan apai mengmeng ua, anungzuite hilh ding in ataita uhi.
english: They departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.

paite: Huan ngai dih, Jesu'n amaute atuak a, "Chibai aw,” achi hi. Huchi in amaute'n akhepek alen ua, abia uhi.
english: As they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, “Rejoice!” They came and took hold of his feet, and worshiped him.

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Lau kei unla, paita un, Galili gam a pai ding in ka unaute va hilh un; huai ah na hon mu ding uh, achi," chi in.
english: Then Jesus said to them, “Don’t be afraid. Go tell my brothers that they should go into Galilee, and there they will see me.”

paite: Huan apai lai un vengmi sepaih khenkhat khopi ah ava lut ua, thil omdan tengteng siampu liante kiang ah ava hilh uhi.
heading: Hankhuk Vengte Thugen
english: Now while they were going, behold, some of the guards came into the city and told the chief priests all the things that had happened.

paite: Upate toh akikhawm ua, akihou zoh un, sepaihte kiang ah dangka tampi apia ua,
english: When they were assembled with the elders and had taken counsel, they gave a large amount of silver to the soldiers,

paite: "Zan a ka ihmut kal un, anungzuite hong pai in, amah aguta uh, chi unla,
english: saying, “Say that his disciples came by night and stole him away while we slept.

paite: gam-ukpa'n huai ana zakleh amah leng i khem ding ua lunghimoh lou ding in i bawl na ke,” achi uhi.
english: If this comes to the governor’s ears, we will persuade him and make you free of worry.”

paite: Huchi in dangka ala ua, ahilh bang un ahihta ua; huchi in tutan in huai thu Judate lak ah agenthang lai uhi.
english: So they took the money and did as they were told. This saying was spread abroad among the Jews, and continues until today.

paite: Himahleh Galili gam a Jesu'n tang a sehsak ah nungzui sawm-le-khatte ahoh uhi.
heading: Thounawn Jesu Leh Nagotna Thupi / (Mar 16.14-18; Luk 24.36-49; Joh 20.19-23; Nas 1.6-8)
english: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had sent them.

paite: Amah amuh un abia ua; khenkhat in aginglah uhi.
english: When they saw him, they bowed down to him; but some doubted.

paite: Huchi in akiang uah Jesu ahong pai a, amau ahoupih a, "Lei leh van a thuneihna tengteng ka kiang a piak ahita.
english: Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.

paite: Huaiziak in kuan unla, nam chih a pan nungzuite bawl unla, Pa toh, Tapa toh, Kha Siangthou toh min in baptis unla,
english: Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

paite: thu ka hon piak tengteng zui ding in thuhilh un. Ngai un, kei tangtawn in, khovel tawp pha in leng, na kiang uah ka om gige hi," achi hi.
english: teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.
